hardware.note: Same machine as 0-measure. Another session (stage 2b) ran Godot tests in between: before every benchmark.cjs call the script waited until no foreign godot/IronStandard process was running (61 waits in the matrix); a process starting during a call cannot be excluded.

method: node godot/tools/benchmark.cjs <exe> --scenario=<s> --n=1000 --ticks=3600 --warmup=120 --seed=4242 --profile-phases --repeat=5 --execution-context=host; sequential; matrix order: contact base,cur; cavalry cur,base; volley base,cur; approach cur,base; siege base,cur; mixed cur,base

builds.base: fec5313 (code of main 2e1ef3f), separate git worktree
builds.cur_cavalry_1: 5615950 with the screen early-out of a815d06 (built before that commit)
